author: reek
body: Stage 5 soundness tripwire for N-ary constructor congruence. The MyCons case of `append xs MyNil === xs` normalizes to `MyCons h (append t MyNil) === MyCons h t`, which holds only via the inductive hypothesis (`cong ih`), NOT by reflexivity. Offering `Refl` asserts `append t MyNil` and `t` are definitionally equal, which they are not. If the curried-constructor peel in the unifier were unsound (collapsing the two arguments), this would be wrongly accepted; it must reject with CDX2001.
